title: Give This Memo A Useful Title
objective: Test whether a tiny model can turn a raw memo into a recognizably useful title.

prompt.task: Write one short title for this memo.
prompt.system: You help label voice memos. Return plain text only. Write a short title the user would recognize later. Do not use quotes. Do not explain your answer.

input.transcript: Okay I need to book the dentist for Friday and send the insurance form before noon.

title: What Kind Of Memo Is This?
objective: Test whether the model can identify the memo's main mode in natural language.

prompt.task: Say what kind of memo this is.
prompt.system: You classify short voice memos. Return plain text only. Use a short phrase like task, reminder, calendar, brainstorm, meeting note, or personal note, followed by a very short reason.

input.transcript: We decided to keep the beta closed another week, and Maya will rewrite the onboarding email before Thursday.

title: What Should The User Do Next?
objective: Test whether the model can identify the practical next step from a memo.

prompt.task: Describe the main next action for the user.
prompt.system: You help turn voice memos into action. Return plain text only. Give one clear next action, not a list.

input.transcript: Tomorrow at nine send Alex the invoice, then remind myself on Friday if he hasn't replied.

discipline: does not contain any of: maybe|might

title: Rewrite This Memo More Clearly
objective: Test whether the model can clean up a transcript without losing key facts.

prompt.task: Rewrite this memo so it is cleaner and easier to read.
prompt.system: You rewrite messy transcripts. Return plain text only. Preserve the facts. Do not add bullet points unless the memo clearly needs them.

input.transcript: Um okay so the thing is we shipped the sync fix and uh support tickets dropped from nineteen to six, but we still have weird duplicate reminders for recurring tasks.

clarity: does not contain any of: um|uh

title: What Matters Most?
objective: Test whether the model can prioritize the most important ideas in a memo.

prompt.task: List the two or three most important points.
prompt.system: You summarize voice memos. Return plain text only. Use short bullet points. Focus on the most important things, not every detail.

input.transcript: Launch date is May tenth. Legal still needs to approve the revised terms. The waitlist form conversion fell after the new design, and I want a fix before the announcement draft goes out.

task: contains any of: may tenth|may 10|launch date

title: Should This Become A Reminder?
objective: Test whether the model can recognize reminder intent and restate it cleanly.

prompt.task: Decide whether this should become a reminder and say what the reminder should be.
prompt.system: You help convert spoken notes into reminders. Return plain text only. If it sounds like a reminder, write one clear reminder sentence. If not, say why not.

input.transcript: Need to maybe ping Chris about the invoice thing before it gets weird.

clarity: does not contain any of: maybe

title: Should This Become A Calendar Event?
objective: Test whether the model can recognize scheduling intent in plain language.

prompt.task: Say whether this sounds like a calendar event.
prompt.system: You help decide whether a voice memo should become a calendar event. Return plain text only. Start with Yes or No, then one short sentence.

input.transcript: Call Sam tomorrow at 2 about the contractor quote.

title: What Follow-Up Question Should We Ask?
objective: Test whether the model can ask the single best missing-information question.

prompt.task: Ask the single best follow-up question, if one is needed.
prompt.system: You help clarify ambiguous memos. Return plain text only. Ask one question if something important is missing. If nothing important is missing, say 'No follow-up needed.'

input.transcript: Remind me to send the deck to Priya.

title: Which Old Memo Is Most Similar?
objective: Test whether the model can make a semantically useful recall choice in plain language.

prompt.task: Choose the most relevant earlier memo and say why.
prompt.system: You help find the most relevant previous memo. Return plain text only. Start with the memo id, then one short reason.

input.query: We should keep the referral program invite-only until analytics migration is done.

candidates.summary: Deferred referral system until analytics migration.
Updated website hero copy and social proof blocks.
Need to book dentist and send insurance form.
